output.title: Compare Two Fictional Service Completion Observations
output.description: Write a brief text comparison of two supplied service observations: service A completed 10 of 10 requests, service B completed 8 of 10 requests. State the completion rates, the difference, and which observation shows the higher completion, using only the supplied facts with no external systems or accounts. The deliverable is a short self-contained comparison submitted directly in Task Node.
steps: State the two supplied observations verbatim: A completed 10 of 10 requests, B completed 8 of 10 requests.
Compute and note each completion result (A: 10/10, B: 8/10) and the difference (2 fewer completions for B).
Write 3 to 6 sentences comparing the observations and concluding which shows the higher completion.
Submit the comparison as text, using only the supplied observations and no external data.
Check that the submission is self-contained and readable without any outside context.

submission_requirement.criteria: A brief pasted text comparison that reports both observations (A: 10/10, B: 8/10), states the difference, identifies which is higher, and references no external systems or accounts.
